title: AURA Localised Antibiogram
description: Pluggable locale antibiogram for AURA Layer-2 (filter + local %-susceptible priors). One file per locale (e.g. us_armd.json, pakistan.json). See ANTIBIOGRAM_README.md.

locale.description: Machine key passed as the `locale` param to /recommend, e.g. 'pakistan'.

generated.description: ISO date this file was assembled/edited.

min_isolates_for_filter.description: Cells with n_isolates below this are treated as not-reportable (CLSI M39 guidance ~30).

unknown_policy.description: Cells with status 'unknown' or tested=false MUST NOT fall back to another locale's rates. They are surfaced as 'insufficient local data'.

id.description: Short key referenced by each cell's source_id.

organisms.description: Keys MUST match the organism strings used by the model/cohort (normalise via the name map; see README).

drugs.description: Keys MUST match the model's `antibiotic` feature names (see README name map).

percent_susceptible.description: Local %-susceptible. NULL only when status is 'unknown'. NOTE: store SUSCEPTIBLE, not resistance — convert (100 - %R).

status.description: 'ok' = usable number. 'unknown' = no local data, do not recommend, do not fall back. 'do_not_use' = clinically flagged off regardless of number (e.g. ceftriaxone for XDR Typhi).

tested.description: Is this bug-drug pair locally tested/reportable at all? false => dropped by the filter layer.

source_id.description: Must match a meta.sources[].id, or 'TODO' for placeholders.
